techniques.name: Rolling Folk Alternating Bass Pattern
techniques.description: Paul Simon's signature fingerstyle groove: alternating thumb between 5th and 4th strings on C, punctuated by syncopated finger plucks on strings 3, 2, and 1

sequence: Affix capo securely to the 2nd fret
Pinch string 5 (bass) and string 2 on beat 1
Follow with index on string 3, thumb on string 4, and middle on string 1
Insert walking bass notes on beats 4-and to connect chords smoothly
tips: Keep the tempo steady at 92 BPM — do not speed up during the chorus
Use Fmaj7 (X-X-3-2-1-0) for a lighter, folkier acoustic texture if barre F is tough
Listen closely to the subtle bass hammer-on from open 4th string to 2nd fret

techniques.name: Walking Basslines & Capo Transposition Mechanics
techniques.description: Using a 2nd-fret capo to transpose C-shapes into concert D major, integrating descending bass walkdowns on strings 5 and 6 to connect C, Am, and G chords seamlessly

notes: Capo 2nd fret: Open C shape sounds as concert D major; Am sounds as Bm; G sounds as A major
Bass transition: C (fret 3 string 5) → B (fret 2 string 5) → Am (open string 5) → G (fret 3 string 6)
Fingerpicking balance: Thumb plays downstrokes on bass strings while fingers 1 and 2 pluck upward
sequence: Affix capo to fret 2 and check intonation on all strings
Walk the bassline cleanly from C down to Am on beats 3 and 4
Step from Am into open G major, letting the treble strings chime
Resolve back into the rolling fingerstyle C major intro figure
tips: Anchor the right-hand pinky lightly on the guitar top if it helps stabilize your alternating thumb
Ensure the walking bass notes sound at equal volume to the chords
Maintain an unhurried, comfortable 92 BPM folk tempo

sections.name: Intro

notes: Capo 2nd fret (sounds in key of D)

sections.progression: C - Am - G - C - Am - G - F - C

Bass walks down to G on string 6
Gentle resolution into F and C

sections.name: Chorus

notes: Shift to minor submediant Am and mediant Em
Dynamic builds to accompany the massive vocal hook
Resolves back to open C major

beginner.title: Master the Capo & Open Chords
steps: Place capo on 2nd fret and check string tuning
Practice open C, Am, G, and Em chord shapes
Strum through the verse progression at 80 BPM

intermediate.title: Master the Fingerpicking Pattern
steps: Learn Paul Simon's alternating thumb pattern on C and Am
Incorporate the walking bass transition from C down to G
Play the full verse and chorus at 92 BPM

advanced.title: Performance & Dual Vocal Phrasing
steps: Incorporate the intricate hammer-ons on the D string
Lead a communal campfire singalong with dynamic build
Deliver the emotional storytelling nuance of the original recording

commonMistakes: Capo placed crookedly causing fret buzz on strings 1 or 6
Rushing the fingerpicking pattern during the chorus
Stopping the alternating thumb when changing chords
practiceRoutine: 2 minutes: Capo tuning check and finger warm-up
5 minutes: Isolated alternating thumb drill on C chord
5 minutes: Chorus singing and playing integration
5 minutes: Full song playthrough at 92 BPM
metronomeWork: Practice at 75 BPM to master the thumb-finger coordination
Advance to 92 BPM once transitions are fluid
Set metronome clicks on beats 2 and 4 for authentic folk sway
